summary: 111, Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce its first-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results, detailing a 33.1% revenue decline to RMB2.4 billion driven by a strategic transition to an asset-light model. The filing discusses divestitures of underperforming subsidiaries and warehouse partnership shifts, but no specific M&A, activist, or special-situation event is presented. It is a routine earnings release with no recommended action, terms, or deal mechanics. As a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16, this 6-K mirrors a US quarterly earnings press release and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
